test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correct spelt words.

options.text: The main problem, I beleive, lies elsewhere.
He said the goverment remained commited to peace.
You could have seen in them a cemetery or a war memorial.
Jerry is an amatuer who dances because he feels like it.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This question directs us to identify the sentence with all words spelt correctly.
 
• The **only sentence with all words spelled correctly** is: "You could have seen in them a cemetery or a war memorial
